reference.text: Ну как ты? Можно начать с первого дня, а можно просто посидеть рядом. Я никуда не тороплюсь.
reference.voiceDescription: A young adult man about 27, native Russian with clear standard Russian pronunciation and no foreign accent. A pleasant warm medium-pitched male voice, not exaggeratedly deep. Calm, kind, casually interested in the woman he is speaking to. Gentle smile, genuine attention and subtle warmth. Give the opening question room with a short natural pause. Reassuring final phrase. Conversational intimate acting without whispering and without announcer style.
